applies_to: Belimo 22PF-.. ultrasonic flow sensors for water and glycol pipes, interface version 4.3.0.
summary: The 22PF is an ultrasonic flow meter for hydronic pipes with a built-in flow-body temperature sensor and glycol detection. On BACnet MS/TP it reports absolute and relative flow, accumulated volume, temperature, glycol concentration and status, plus an extra sensor input. It has no setpoint or control objects; it is a monitoring device.
notes: The document prints access as R / W; those objects are listed here as writable (W).
The Network Port object (instance 101) holds the MS/TP MAC address, baud rate and max master as writable properties.
Flow, volume and temperature units follow MV 123, MV 126 and MV 127.
Measuring range depends on pipe size (DN); see the product datasheet.
Sensor 1 objects (AI 20, BI 20) are out of service unless MV 220 selects the matching sensor type.

integration.summary: Pure monitoring device: set the engineering units once (MV 123, MV 126, MV 127), then poll or COV-subscribe flow, volume and temperature. Use MV 99 SummaryStatus and AV 140 ErrorState for alarms.

minimum_points.name: T_UnitSel
minimum_points.why: Water temperature at the flow body

integration.remote_sensors: Sensor 1 on Y3 can be read over BACnet as a voltage (AI 20) or switch (BI 20) once MV 220 is set to that type.
setup: MS/TP: baud 9600-115200, default 38400; MAC address 0-127, default 1; max 32 nodes without repeater.
MS/TP MAC and baud can also be changed through the Network Port object (NPO 101).
Configure with Belimo Assistant 2; bus termination is set there and shown in BV 99.
gotchas: Writable persistent objects must not be written on a regular basis.
Changing unit-select MVs changes the units of the flow, volume and temperature objects; update BMS scaling.

points.units: m³/s, m³/h, l/s, l/min, l/h, gpm or cfm (MV 123)

points.name: ErrorState
points.states: Bit 3=Reverse flow, 6=Flow actual exceeds flow nominal, 7=Flow measurement error, 9=Flowbody temperature error, 11=Freeze warning, 12=Glycol detected
